rows.ja: 配信プラットフォーム

relations.text: 2025年12月期の収益の62%、総予約額の61%がApple App Store経由である
relations.text_en: Duolingo derived 62% of its revenue and 61% of its total bookings from the Apple App Store in 2025

source.label: Duolingo 10-K
source.quote: In the twelve months ended December 31, 2025, we derived 62% of our revenue and 61% of our total bookings from the Apple App Store, and 20% of our revenue and 21% of our total bookings from the Google Play Store.

relations.text: Appleとの配信契約は、Appleが30日前の書面通知で解約できる
relations.text_en: The distribution agreement with Apple is generally terminable by Apple with 30 days prior written notice

source.label: Duolingo 10-K
source.quote: In addition, our distribution agreements with Apple and Google are generally terminable by Apple or Google without cause with 30 days prior written notice (to the extent allowed by applicable local law).

relations.text: 2025年12月期の収益の20%、総予約額の21%がGoogle Play経由である
relations.text_en: Duolingo derived 20% of its revenue and 21% of its total bookings from the Google Play Store in 2025

source.label: Duolingo 10-K
source.quote: In the twelve months ended December 31, 2025, we derived 62% of our revenue and 61% of our total bookings from the Apple App Store, and 20% of our revenue and 21% of our total bookings from the Google Play Store.

relations.text: Googleとの配信契約は、Googleが30日前の書面通知で解約できる
relations.text_en: The distribution agreement with Google is generally terminable by Google with 30 days prior written notice

source.label: Duolingo 10-K
source.quote: In addition, our distribution agreements with Apple and Google are generally terminable by Apple or Google without cause with 30 days prior written notice (to the extent allowed by applicable local law).

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
